summary: American Healthcare REIT filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing entry into a new at-the-market equity sales agreement for up to $1.75 billion of common stock through ten named agents, with forward-sale capacity. The company simultaneously terminated its prior ATM program dated February 27, 2026, under which roughly $170.1 million remained unsold. Shares may be sold at prevailing market prices on the NYSE or in negotiated block trades at the company's discretion. This is a routine shelf takedown vehicle, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any forward-sale overhang.
